pages.title: Anybody Home?
pages.text: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Keep the native Wither and dragon victory requirements. Prepare Voidrake materials, Void Scale Blocks, Dragon Heads and a Beacon for the native ritual. This encounter is optional for the twelve eyes.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Endorah is a genuine optional boss, not a required eye.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Keep native Wither/Dragon flags and the Void Scale Block/Dragon Head/Beacon ritual. Defeat both side heads first; they protect the main head and can regrow.
